title: Fauvist Pop
description: Un style d'illustration numérique contemporain mêlant le blocage des couleurs fauvistes à des textures expressives au pinceau sec. Il se caractérise par des lignes d'encre déconnectées et ondulées, des pointillés texturés et des formes géométriques plates et très saturées pour déconstruire les formes.
description_en: A contemporary digital illustration style blending Fauvist color blocking with expressive drybrush textures. It features disconnected, squiggly ink lines, textural stippling, and flat, highly saturated geometric shapes to deconstruct forms.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration numérique contemporain mêlant le blocage des couleurs fauvistes à des textures expressives au pinceau sec. Il se caractérise par des lignes d'encre déconnectées et ondulées, des pointillés texturés et des formes géométriques plates et très saturées pour déconstruire les formes.
prompt: Digital illustration mimicking dry brush painting, screen printing, and gouache. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, no canvas edges, full bleed to all four corners. The rendering relies on flat, highly saturated blocks of {{primary_color}}, {{accent_color}}, and {{secondary_color}} with zero gradients. Lighting is treated entirely as flat graphic elements, discarding realistic volumetric shading in favor of stark, contrasting color fields that define form. Line work consists of bold, loose, disconnected black ink strokes and expressive, rhythmic squiggles that suggest boundaries without fully enclosing forms. Incorporate textural stippling, coarse halftone dots, and spray-paint splatter effects to create transitions between certain color zones. Edges are a dynamic mix of sharp, crisp cut-outs and rough, ragged drybrush marks trailing off into the void. The materiality evokes rough watercolor paper or screen-print canvas, where brush strokes leave behind visible bristle marks, chalky noise, and textural imperfections. Subjects are deconstructed into stylized, organic, and angular patches. The overall rhythm is energetic and chaotic, capturing a rapid, abstract pop-art execution with a strictly 2D, flat spatial dynamic. digital painting, drybrush illustration, fauvist pop art, flat color blocking, expressive ink lines, stipple shading, graphic gouache, abstract shapes, rough edges, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Color blocks shift and snap into place like stop-motion cutouts, while the disconnected ink squiggles writhe and redraw themselves at a low frame rate (e.g., 12fps).
video.camera: Static 2D camera with zero parallax or perspective shifts, maintaining a completely flat graphic plane.
video.temporal_texture: The drybrush textures, stippling, and canvas noise boil constantly, creating a flickering, hand-painted tactile energy.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth 3D interpolation, volumetric shadows, gradient morphing, or realistic motion blur.
